offer.text: Sleepless nights bring winged horrors down on us. Strike three phantoms from the sky before they carry off a sleeper.

accept.text: Keep your eyes up and your aim true.

decline.text: Then we duck and pray when they swoop.

in_progress.text: Still hearing those shrieks overhead. Three of them.

ready.text: The sky's quiet again. Good shooting.

complete.text: Folk can rest without watching the rafters now. My thanks.
